Beat 6: Undergoing a second kidney transplant donated by her brother after her body rejected the first, she kept smiling.

**The secret behind Modern Family's bravest star:**
• Born with kidney dysplasia, she underwent sixteen surgeries including two kidney transplants donated by her father and younger brother.
• Attended the Professional Performing Arts School in Manhattan before landing Modern Family at age eighteen.
• Won four Screen Actors Guild Awards and starred on Broadway in The Great Gatsby and Just in Time.

Who should Haley Dunphy have ended up with: Dylan or Andy?
